title: Introduction to Computer Science
syllabus: Problem solving using computing; variables, conditional execution, loops, functions, arrays, recursion, pointers, simple sorting and searching algorithms, file I/O, object-oriented concepts.
learning_objectives: Equip students with procedural and basic object-oriented problem-solving skills in Python and C/C++.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 112

title: Calculus
syllabus: Real numbers, sequences and series, convergence tests, power series, Taylor series, functions of several variables, partial derivatives, chain rule, directional derivatives, gradient, extrema, multiple integrals, vector calculus, Green's and Stokes' theorems.
learning_objectives: Master single and multivariable calculus fundamental to all engineering disciplines.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Maths Dept, p. 180

title: Linear Algebra and Differential Equations
syllabus: Vector spaces, subspaces, linear independence, basis and dimension, linear transformations, matrices, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, diagonalization, inner product spaces. First and second order ordinary differential equations, system of linear differential equations.
learning_objectives: Develop matrix algebra, linear transformations, eigensystems, and analytical ODE solutions critical for advanced computation and machine learning.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Maths Dept, p. 181

title: Electromagnetic Waves and Quantum Mechanics
syllabus: Maxwell equations, wave equation, electromagnetic radiation and polarization. Wave-particle duality, de Broglie hypothesis, Heisenberg uncertainty principle, Schrodinger equation, potential wells and barrier tunneling.
learning_objectives: Establish foundational electromagnetic physics and wave mechanics principles for engineering analysis.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Physics Dept, p. 204

title: Introduction to Electrical Engineering
syllabus: Circuit analysis, KVL, KCL, Thevenin and Norton equivalents, steady-state AC circuits, transformers, operational amplifiers, diodes, transistors as switches, logic gates.
learning_objectives: Analyze linear electrical circuits, operational amplifier circuits, and basic semiconductor devices.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, EE Dept, p. 142

title: Data Structures and Algorithms
syllabus: Asymptotic notation, amortized analysis. Stacks, queues, linked lists, binary trees, AVL trees, Red-Black trees, B-trees. Heaps and priority queues. Hashing. Sorting algorithms. Graph representations, BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Prim, Kruskal. Dynamic programming fundamentals.
learning_objectives: Design, analyze, and implement robust, high-performance data structures and core algorithmic primitives.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 113

title: Digital Logic and System Design
syllabus: Boolean algebra, logic minimization using Karnaugh maps and Quine-McCluskey, combinational logic (adders, multiplexers, decoders), sequential circuits, flip-flops, finite state machines (Mealy and Moore), timing analysis, FPGA design flow using VHDL/Verilog.
learning_objectives: Synthesize and test synchronous digital circuits and finite state machines.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 114

title: Computer Architecture
syllabus: Instruction set architecture (RISC-V/MIPS), CPU datapath and control unit, pipelining, pipeline hazards and branch prediction, memory hierarchy, cache design, virtual memory, I/O systems and bus protocols.
learning_objectives: Understand microarchitectural execution, pipeline hazards, and cache hierarchy optimization.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 115

title: Programming Languages
syllabus: Formal semantics, lambda calculus, functional programming paradigms (SML/Haskell), type systems and type inference, operational semantics, control abstractions, memory management, garbage collection.
learning_objectives: Evaluate programming language paradigms, rigorous type systems, and operational semantics.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 116

title: Operating Systems
syllabus: Process management, threads, concurrency, synchronization primitives (mutex, semaphores, monitors), CPU scheduling, deadlocks, memory virtualization, paging and segmentation, page replacement algorithms, file systems, disk scheduling, virtualization and OS security.
learning_objectives: Implement system-level concurrency, process schedulers, and virtual memory paging mechanisms.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 117

title: Analysis and Design of Algorithms
syllabus: Advanced algorithmic design: divide-and-conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, network flow (Ford-Fulkerson, max-flow min-cut theorem), NP-completeness, reductions, approximation algorithms, randomized algorithms.
learning_objectives: Prove algorithmic correctness, prove NP-completeness reductions, and formulate polynomial-time approximations.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 118

title: Introduction to Automata and Theory of Computation
syllabus: Finite automata (DFA, NFA), regular languages, pumping lemma for regular languages, context-free grammars, pushdown automata, Turing machines, decidability, undecidability, Halting problem, Rice's theorem.
learning_objectives: Classify formal languages through abstract computational automata and prove computational undecidability.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 119

title: Introduction to Database Management Systems
syllabus: Relational data model, relational algebra, SQL (DDL, DML, advanced aggregations, window functions), relational design theory, functional dependencies, normal forms (1NF through BCNF), indexing (B+ trees, hash index), query optimization, transaction processing, ACID properties, concurrency control (2PL, timestamp), crash recovery (WAL).
learning_objectives: Design normalized relational schemas, write high-performance SQL queries, and configure transaction concurrency control.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 120

title: Introduction to Parallel and Distributed Computing
syllabus: Shared memory programming (OpenMP, pthreads), distributed memory programming (MPI), GPU programming with CUDA, parallel algorithm design, load balancing, synchronization latency, distributed consensus basics.
learning_objectives: Develop high-throughput parallel algorithms leveraging multicore and GPU architectures.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 122

title: Machine Learning
syllabus: Supervised learning: linear regression, logistic regression, Generalized Linear Models, SVMs and kernels, decision trees, boosting. Unsupervised learning: k-means, Gaussian Mixture Models, EM algorithm, PCA. Learning theory: PAC bounds, VC dimension. Neural networks: backpropagation, regularization, deep architectures.
learning_objectives: Mathematically formulate and implement supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 128

title: Advanced Artificial Intelligence
syllabus: Search algorithms (A*, IDA*), adversarial game search, constraint satisfaction problems (CSP), probabilistic reasoning, Bayesian networks, Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), reinforcement learning (Q-learning, policy gradients).
learning_objectives: Formulate autonomous decision-making using heuristic state-space search and reinforcement learning.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 127

title: Introduction to Logic and Functional Programming
syllabus: Propositional logic, first-order predicate logic, natural deduction, resolution refutation, Horn clauses, logic programming in Prolog, unification algorithms, formal program verification.
learning_objectives: Construct formal mathematical logic deductions and write declarative logic programs in Prolog.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 126

title: Design Practices in Computer Science
syllabus: Software engineering methodologies, version control (Git), modern software architecture (microservices, REST, MVC), continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), software testing (unit, integration, mock testing), Agile sprint workflows.
learning_objectives: Collaboratively engineer production-grade software applications applying CI/CD and automated testing.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 124

title: Design Project in Computer Science
syllabus: Individual or small-group faculty-supervised design and engineering project tackling a real-world software, systems, or machine learning engineering challenge.
learning_objectives: Execute a full-cycle engineering capstone project from requirements specification to deployment and verification.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, CSE Dept, p. 125

title: Probability and Stochastic Processes
syllabus: Probability axioms, conditional probability, Bayes theorem, random variables, distribution functions, expectation, variance, joint distributions, limit theorems (Law of Large Numbers, Central Limit Theorem), discrete-time Markov chains, Poisson processes.
learning_objectives: Apply rigorous probabilistic modeling, expectation calculus, and Markov chain dynamics.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Maths Dept, p. 183

title: Transport Phenomena
syllabus: Unified treatment of momentum, heat, and mass transport. Viscosity and shell momentum balances, equations of change for isothermal systems, thermal conductivity and energy transport, diffusivity and mass flux.
learning_objectives: Formulate and solve partial differential equations governing momentum, heat, and mass transfer in chemical systems.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Chemical Dept, p. 95

title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics
syllabus: First and second laws of thermodynamics, PVT behavior of pure fluids, equation of state, residual properties, phase equilibria in multicomponent systems, Raoult's and Henry's laws, activity coefficient models, chemical reaction equilibria.
learning_objectives: Calculate vapor-liquid equilibria, fugacities, and reaction equilibrium conversions for industrial processes.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Chemical Dept, p. 96

title: Chemical Reaction Engineering I
syllabus: Kinetics of homogeneous reactions, rate equations, interpretation of batch reactor data. Ideal reactor sizing: batch, CSTR, PFR. Multiple reactor configurations, recycle reactors. Temperature and pressure effects in non-isothermal reactors.
learning_objectives: Size ideal chemical reactors and design optimal reactor networks for single and multiple reactions.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Chemical Dept, p. 97

title: Chemical Reaction Engineering II
syllabus: Non-ideal flow, residence time distribution (RTD) models, dispersion model, tanks-in-series model. Heterogeneous reactions: solid-catalyzed gas reactions, effectiveness factors, mass and heat transfer in porous catalysts, fluid-fluid reactions.
learning_objectives: Model non-ideal residence time flow patterns and design catalytic packed bed and fluidized reactors.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Chemical Dept, p. 98

title: Heat Transfer for Chemical Engineers
syllabus: Steady and transient heat conduction. Forced and natural convection. Boiling and condensation. Radiation heat transfer. Design of shell-and-tube heat exchangers, compact heat exchangers, evaporators.
learning_objectives: Design and rate industrial shell-and-tube heat exchangers and reboilers.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Chemical Dept, p. 99

title: Mass Transfer I
syllabus: Molecular diffusion in fluids, mass transfer coefficients, film and penetration theories. Interphase mass transfer. Distillation: McCabe-Thiele and Ponchon-Savarit methods, packed and tray columns, reflux ratio, column efficiency. Gas absorption and stripping.
learning_objectives: Calculate theoretical stages and column height for binary distillation and gas absorption columns.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Chemical Dept, p. 100

title: Process Dynamics and Control
syllabus: Dynamic modeling of chemical processes, transfer functions, first and second order systems, feedback controllers (P, PI, PID), closed-loop stability analysis (Routh-Hurwitz, Bode and Nyquist plots), controller tuning, cascade and feedforward control.
learning_objectives: Formulate transfer function models and tune feedback PID control loops for chemical processes.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Chemical Dept, p. 101

title: Major Project in Chemical Engineering
syllabus: Comprehensive capstone process plant design, simulation using Aspen Plus, economic evaluation, safety analysis, HAZOP study, and detailed equipment specification.
learning_objectives: Deliver a complete industrial plant design report incorporating Aspen simulation and safety HAZOP.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, Chemical Dept, p. 103

title: Introduction to Psychology
syllabus: Biological bases of behavior, cognitive processes: perception, memory, learning, problem solving, decision making. Theories of intelligence and personality. Social cognition, attitudes, group dynamics, motivation and emotion.
learning_objectives: Understand fundamental psychological principles of cognition, learning, and social dynamics.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, HSS Dept, p. 165

title: Introduction to Indian Society and Culture
syllabus: Social structure of Indian society: caste, class, kinship, religion. Social change, modernization, urbanization, globalization. Constitutional principles, diversity, federalism, contemporary social movements in India.
learning_objectives: Analyze structural social realities, constitutional values, and contemporary social dynamics in India.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, HSS Dept, p. 168

title: Environment, Development and Society
syllabus: Ecology, environmental ethics, sustainable development, political economy of natural resources, climate change policy, international treaties, environmental governance in India.
learning_objectives: Critique environmental policy frameworks and sustainable development paradigms.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, HSS Dept, p. 170

title: Entrepreneurship and New Venture Creation
syllabus: Opportunity identification, lean startup methodology, customer discovery, minimum viable product (MVP) development, business model canvas, venture financing, term sheets, equity dilution, intellectual property protection.
learning_objectives: Develop a viable business plan, articulate value propositions, and navigate early-stage venture funding.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, DMS, p. 192

title: Financial Management and Venture Valuation
syllabus: Time value of money, capital budgeting (NPV, IRR), financial statement analysis (income statement, balance sheet, cash flows), cost of capital, working capital management, DCF and VC valuation methods.
learning_objectives: Perform corporate financial analysis, evaluate investment projects, and calculate startup valuations.
source: IIT Delhi Courses of Study 2023-24, DMS, p. 194
